signals.title: @DIPYOMUCH: God's Eye View is an open source project that allows you to fuse together publicly available information to get a God's Eye View of the worl
signals.content: God's Eye View is an open source project that allows you to fuse together publicly available information to get a God's Eye View of the world. Using aggregated location data from TomTom, it shows you how busy every street is. In cities like Austin and London, you can go look at actual CCTV cameras to see the real conditions on the ground. It truly feels like you're in a spy thriller movie, except the data is real and the code is inspectable. MIT license so you open source intelligence and geospatial intelligence nerds can go wild building on it. GitHub here: https://t.co/AmM3ZF9ZaT
